question: The Red Fort Complex in New Delhi was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2007.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Fort Complex**

 
 
• It was built by the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan.
 
• Shah Jahan commissioned construction of the Red Fort on **12 May 1638,** when he decided to shift his capital from **Agra to Delhi.**
 
• Red Fort is the fusion of the Timurids and the Persians architectural styles. 
 
• Ustad Ahmad Lahauri was the architect of the Red Fort.
 
• Indo-Islamic and Mughal architectural styles are present in the Red Fort Complex.
 
• The fort was designated a **UNESCO World Heritage site **in **2007****.** 
 
• It is situated on the Banks of **River Yamuna.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Shah Jahan

 
 
• Shahjahan was the fifth Mughal emperor of India and was the son of Jahangir.
 
• His grandfather Akbar gave him the name Khurram.
 
• He was given the title of "The Builder of the Marvels" as he had a remarkable ability to design new structures and redesign old forts.
 
• He built the Taj Mahal in Agra, the Moti Masjid in Lahore, the Jama Masjid of Delhi, and Section of Agra Fort, etc.
